Inputs are valid and always include timezone offsets. Export due through api.py. Preserve api.health() returning {"status":"ok","version":1}. Standard library only.

files.core.py:
from datetime import datetime
def due(events,now):
    cutoff=datetime.fromisoformat(now).replace(tzinfo=None)
    return [e['id'] for e in events if datetime.fromisoformat(e['at']).replace(tzinfo=None) <= cutoff]
